intro_detail: I make games, I’m interested in AI and I like 3D rendering.
selection_note: A selection of projects from my studies.
projects_intro: A few projects from my studies: a 3D game, generative plants and an Android puzzle.
spellwar_summary: A 3D game with a custom engine in C++ and OpenGL.
spellwar_detail: SpellWar is a third-person game set on floating platforms. I developed the engine from scratch.
spellwar_focus: A custom physics model, collision system, PBR renderer and terrain generation.
plants_summary: Plants generated using L-systems, with 3D rendering in WebGL.
plants_detail: This project started with reading The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants (ABOP). It was mainly about studying the ideas and putting them into practice.
plants_focus: The project brings together L-systems, maths, physics and 3D rendering in the browser with WebGL.
eyefox_summary: An Android puzzle developed during my studies.
eyefox_detail: The goal is to make two grids match. Changing a tile’s colour also changes its neighbours.
eyefox_focus: Build a puzzle around this rule and make it work on a phone.
about_body: I like code that produces striking visual results. I enjoy using maths and physics to represent a problem and learning different ways to solve it. I also care about keeping the software architecture clean.
about_outro: My work includes talking with the client, designing the product and developing it. I also handle the infrastructure, pipelines and deployment.
approach_1_body: I like designing games. One day, I’d like to make a game or tell a story with something to say.
approach_2_body: Understanding how models work and how they’re built, as well as making software that uses them.
approach_3_body: Making striking images, with the maths and physics that go into creating them.
